cohort: 821 mothers with births documented at Arba Minch Hospital between January 2017 and June 2017, with 274 cases (perinatal deaths) and 547 controls (live births).
finding: Obstetric complications, use of partograph, gestational age, and mode of delivery were significantly associated with perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a determinant of perinatal mortality (AOR 0.167; 95% CI 0.084-0.331).
